pages.text: When a hit reaches final damage, a worn Vampiric Amulet has a 17.5 percent chance to spend 50 Grimoire power, cancel the remaining damage, heal one heart and grant eight seconds of Absorption I. It does not spend power on a failed roll.

The effect is checked after armor and existing absorption; it does not refund resources already consumed during the hit. A successful activation precedes protective-poppet handling. It is a chance-based defense, not guaranteed death protection.

The amulet uses a Necklace slot. Despot demon merchants can offer it at career level five; a master Hedge Witch can also select it from the accessory pool. These offers are randomized, so a particular merchant need not stock it. See $(l:sympathy/demon)Demon Merchants$(). There is no crafting recipe. The Hedge Witch base offer is 8-16 emeralds; general Curio also accepts the amulet.
